# Synthetic failure capture after the audit/06 fixes to the opt-in two_stage_v3 layout

Source commit d55e74e1a846821963bf5d2119e07bab81453b09 (v3 shared compaction reserve, explicit public agree evidence, recorded local rule, restore checks; replay with the record's technicalTrial; S4 agree window and ledger checks). Two independent captures were made on a clean tree with the generator (`node tests/support/generate-failure-fixture.ts <dir>`); they differ from each other only at 15 run-ID leaves.

Compared with the replaced failure-path-two-stage-v3-3c8046a capture (never adopted outside this branch, removed), records differ only at 26 leaves: 15 run IDs, 10 instruction-source hash leaves (`decision/jev-decision.ts` and `v2/jev-turn.ts` in each of the 5 scenarios) and the derived `identity.prompts` digest. Every request payload, behavior, schema, failure, clock, policy, call/send and storage is unchanged. The generator writes a stale baseCommit literal; it was set by hand to the source commit above. Earlier adopted fixture directories (including failure-path-repair-facts-e6e2c67) remain byte-identical. No real API, Keychain, .env, study data or live run was used.
